reuse.why: Changes only the existing isSkippedDay predicate, which every holiday check in the tree (getNextDate, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, the schedule handlers) already goes through.

duplication.why: No logic is added outside the one shared predicate.

placement.why: The matching rule stays in shared/schedules where the holiday predicate is defined.

scope.why: A few lines in isSkippedDay plus two tests.

maintainability.why: Holiday matching remains defined in exactly one small function.
